caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, lightly textured, beige or off-white background. The object appears to be a metal artifact, illustrated in shades of gray and black, suggesting a three-dimensional form through subtle shading. It has a flat, elongated horizontal base that curves into a loop on the left side, and tapers to a point on the right. Attached to the base near its center is a small, shallow, cup-shaped depression, and rising vertically from this area is a hook-like projection that curves backward over the body of the object. There are no other visible elements or decorations in the composition aside from the artist signature in the lower left corner.
title: Miner's Candle Holder
